description:
Realistimo (Реалистимо) helps you find real property listings in Bulgaria — apartments, houses, offices, and more — directly in ChatGPT.

Describe what you're looking for in English or Bulgarian (city, neighborhood, budget, sale or rent). The app shows interactive maps with neighborhoods, photos, prices in euros, and links to the full listings on Realistimo.

Good for: 
• Searching for houses and apartments for sale or rent in Sofia, Plovdiv, Varna, Burgas, Ruse, Stara Zagora and other cities; 
• Filtering by location and deal type (sale / rent); 
• Viewing details and opening the listing on Realistimo for more information.

Data comes from public listings on realistimo.com. The app does not show broker phone numbers or personal contact details — use the official listing page on Realistimo to get in touch.
